title: Effect of vacuum heat treatment on microstructure and microhardness of cold sprayed Cu-4Cr-2Nb alloy coating
InformationInFigures: Yes. Powder morphology in Fig. 1a., Microhardness in Fig. 6

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: Spherical, some larger particles and many smaller particles. many small Cr2Nb precipitates uniformly distributed in the matrix

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: commercially available cold spray gun (CGT GmbH, Germany)

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: No oxidation occurred. interfaces between the deposited particles in the coating are clearly revealed. It is clear that the deposited particles have experienced intensive deformation and deformed to an elongated shape. As for the Cr2Nb precipitates, they are the same as those in the feedstock, which are homogeneously dispersed in the matrix
